_method_note: REPRODUCIBILITY HEADER. Every row carries method + sources + routes in source_refs/notes so any entity can rerun the same path. Routes: (a) census = Census COG 1992/2012/2014 individual-unit public-use files (_census/ dir; parser census_universal_parser_v1-class, E-code letter dictionary verified against each vintage tech doc; NO literal mental-health code exists in any COG vintage — the E50/51/52 public-welfare reference maps to Housing&CD E50 / Libraries E52, E51 does not exist; the MH-proximal countable family is E32 health/E36+E38 hospitals/E67-E79 welfare-vendor-cash-institutional family: banked as census_welfare_health_family_usd); (b) SAMHSA = USASpending v2 spending_by_award, SAMHSA-CFDA award set {93.242, 93.243, 93.958, 93.959, 93.944, 93.977, 93.230, 93.245, 93.244, 93.952, 93.941}, state place-of-performance universe then recipient-name city attribution (POP city fields are null in USASpending feed; rule = case-insensitive token match on recipient name, undercounts non-city-named recipients — noted-grain); year = federal FY of award start; SAMHSA = federal_external channel: noted-never-summed (fund-aware-v2); (c) facilities = SAMHSA treatment locator backend (findtreatment.gov /locator/listing county-grain, snapshot Nov 2026, dedupe on name+street+zip); (d) suicide = CDC Socrata psx4-wq38 Mapping IOV All_Suicide county rows 2019-2024, NYC = unweighted mean of 5 counties (flagged), Boston row = geoid 25017 Middlesex County proxy (NOT Suffolk — honest-flag); (e) MH/SUD sublines = capture-as-declared from local budget books only where the books PRINT the line (books' own structure IS the taxonomy; no forced split; combined lines stay combined; the bh_combined column stays null unless a printed combined line was captured).
